featured.title: Catalog Order Service
featured.blurb: interactive Java 21 / Spring Boot order service: atomic conditional stock updates prevent overselling, unique idempotency keys make retries safe, multi-item failures roll back as one transaction, and shipping commits before bounded asynchronous webhook delivery. Spring JDBC + H2 + Docker, with a real two-thread last-unit race and 45 passing tests

featured.title: Grantline
featured.blurb: passwordless access broker in Go: humans, machines, and AI agents prove an ed25519 key, receive a 5-minute grant, then open policy-checked sessions. Tenant comes from the grant (spoof headers ignored), kind+role is authorization, and identity/session/audit lists are server-paginated. React console + RFD; stdlib only, tested and CI-checked

featured.title: Clearbay
featured.blurb: multi-tenant 3PL operations API that maps to JASCI-style work: tenant-scoped OAuth (JWT `tid` claim, spoof headers ignored), RBAC from token roles, sub-second inventory search (one query + tenant-versioned cache), MCP tools with JSON Schema guardrails and a readable audit log, a configurable billing engine, and async jobs with delayed retry. Spring Boot 4.1 + PostgreSQL + Redis, tested and CI-checked

featured.title: Dockline
featured.blurb: eval-first warehouse ops agent that only acts through Clearbay MCP. 40 rule-scored cases lock tenant isolation, read-only writes, extra JSON fields, and vague-prompt refusals. Deterministic router by default (optional OpenAI tools); the model is never the judge. FastAPI + traces — the on-site loop you bring to an existing MCP API

featured.title: Durable Brief
featured.blurb: a one-page briefing desk on the Vercel Workflow SDK: parallel research, sequential draft, evaluator-optimizer loop, then a human approval hook. Close the tab or redeploy — the run is still waiting; publish has not happened.

featured.title: PulseQueue
featured.blurb: watch a job queue work in real time: workers lease jobs, retries use exponential backoff, and poison messages land in a dead-letter queue. Pure TypeScript queue engine (no HTTP in the core, so lease exclusivity and DLQ rules are unit-tested) with a React dashboard over Server-Sent Events.

featured.title: SketchSync
featured.blurb: realtime collaborative whiteboard: shareable rooms, live named cursors, per-user undo, and PNG export. Raw WebSockets (no Socket.IO) over a typed message protocol; Node.js + Express server with unit-tested room logic, React canvas frontend.

featured.title: ResuMatch
featured.blurb: paste a resume and a job description, get a 0–100 match score, skill-gap breakdown, and concrete suggestions. Deterministic TF-IDF + skill-extraction core with an optional LLM coaching layer; React 19 + TypeScript frontend, FastAPI backend, tested and CI-checked.

featured.title: xingjiyan.com
featured.blurb: systems-first portfolio: on-call for tenants, retries, and agents that fail closed. Clearbay, Grantline, Failure Playground, and a note — The model is never the judge. M.S. ECE, Carnegie Mellon.
